subject: How to show data on top of an image in shiny

messages.author: 6aa49e9b97383522
messages.subject: How to show data on top of an image in shiny
parts:
Hello, 

I would like to display (and dynamically change) data displayed in an R-Shiny App.  I can do the plotting on an image (without shiny and without dynamic control) as described here.  How can I do this in R shiny?  Here is what I have so far (I am yet to implement dynamic control).   

This raises an error in the Server.R code at "lim<-par()".  I am new to R and to shiny, so this may be a simple mistake and easy fix (I hope so.)

Thanks in advance,
Dustin

[Server.R]

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(png)

ima <- readPNG("my_image.png")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

     output$text1 <- renderText({ 
          "You have selected this"
     })
  output$plot <- {
     return(
     plot(c(1, 2), c(2, 1))
     lim<-par()
     rasterImage(ima, lim$usr[1], lim$usr[3], lim$usr[2], lim$usr[4])
     lines(c(1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0), c(1, 1.3, 1.7, 1.6, 1.7, 1.0), type="b", lwd=5, col="white")
     )
     }
}
)


[ui.R]

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Dynamic Data Display"),
    
  fluidRow(
    
    column(3,
      selectInput("day", label = h3("Select weekday"), 
        choices = list("Monday" = 1, "Tuesday" = 2,
                       "Wednesday" = 3, "Thursday" = 4,
    "Friday" = 5, "Saturday" = 6,
    "Sunday" = 7), selected = 1)),
    
    column(3, 
      sliderInput("Time", label = h3("Select time"),
        min = 0, max = 23, value = 8))
   
  ),
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("plot")
  )
))
